summary: Iran's senior IRGC advisor vows missile strikes will continue until war's last day regardless of duration, while Trump claims total US control over Iran's finances and the Strait of Hormuz. Israel's Defense Minister Katz declares permanent presence in security zones across Lebanon, Syria, and Gaza. US helicopter fired on a vessel in the Gulf of Oman, and Iraq sets a final September 30 deadline for coalition withdrawal.
key_points: IRGC Gen. Naqdi states Iran will fire missiles until the last day of war even if it lasts years; if missiles run out, Iran becomes more dangerous to US global interests. (Source: @naya_foriraq/87636)

Trump asserts US has complete control over Iran's money and the Strait of Hormuz, describing a 'steel wall' naval blockade; claims Iran has no navy, unpaid soldiers, 300% inflation. (Source: @lelotsenzura/94125)
Defense Minister Katz in Lebanon: Israel will not withdraw from security zones in Lebanon, Syria, or Gaza; will keep destroying Iranian-funded terror infrastructure. (Source: @amitsegal/63838)
IDF struck a Hamas cell leader in northern Gaza planning imminent terror attacks against Israeli forces. (Source: @almogboker78/17945)
US Army confirms a US helicopter fired a missile at a ship in the Gulf of Oman; the ship is no longer sailing to Iran. (Source: @New_security8200/203276)
Iraqi National Security Council declares the September 30 deadline for ending the international coalition mission in Iraq is final and irreversible. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/384219)
IDF interceptor fired at a target later identified as friendly fire in the southern Lebanon security zone; no casualties; incident under investigation. (Source: @New_security8200/203277)
Reports of explosions and missile launches toward the Strait of Hormuz from southern Iran, per IRGC-affiliated channels. (Source: @pkpoi/143586)

sections.executive_summary: Iran's top IRGC advisor Gen. Mohammad Naqdi declares Iran will launch missiles until the final day of any conflict regardless of duration, warning that a missile-depleted Iran would be more dangerous to US global interests. Simultaneously, Trump claims absolute US control over Iran's financial assets and the Strait of Hormuz, describing a 'steel wall' blockade while asserting Iran's military is broken and its economy collapsing at 300% inflation. Israel's Defense Minister Katz, speaking from Lebanon, commits to permanent retention of security zones in Lebanon, Syria, and Gaza and vows continued destruction of Iranian-funded terror infrastructure. A US helicopter engagement in the Gulf of Oman and Iraq's firm September 30 coalition withdrawal deadline further heighten regional tension.

points: IRGC senior advisor Gen. Mohammad Naqdi states that even if the war continues for years, Iran will fire missiles until the very last day; he adds that if a day comes when Iran has no missiles left, it will be more dangerous to America because the US has thousands of economic interests worldwide. (Source: @naya_foriraq/87636, @SharghDaily/177642)

Trump claims the United States has complete control over Iran's money and assets, stating Iran's inflation has reached 300%, it cannot pay its soldiers, the IRGC is beaten and fleeing, and its leadership is unstable; he presents two options: let Iran collapse economically or strike 'very, very hard.' (Source: @mamlekate/104126, @lelotsenzura/94125, @naya_foriraq/87641)
Explosions reported in southern Iran with IRGC-affiliated channels describing missile launches directed toward the Strait of Hormuz. (Source: @pkpoi/143586)

Iran's Deputy Foreign Minister Kazem Gharibabadi calls on all Caspian Sea coastal states to explicitly condemn recent aggressive actions by Israel and Ukraine, emphasizing the need to uphold national sovereignty and territorial integrity. (Source: @presstv/202520)

Defense Minister Israel Katz, during a visit to Lebanon, declares Israel will not withdraw from security zones in Lebanon, Syria, or Gaza and will continue destroying all terror infrastructure built with Iranian funding. (Source: @amitsegal/63838)
IDF struck and killed a Hamas cell leader in northern Gaza who was planning terror attack patterns against Israeli forces operating in the Strip. (Source: @inon_yttach/9842, @almogboker78/17945)

IDF Spokesperson reports Israeli civilians entered Palestinian homes in the villages of Qusra and Jalud in the Shomron Brigade area, calling it illegal and disgraceful; a closed military zone order was imposed on non-residents, and an ambulance was stopped after Israeli civilians tried to use it to enter the closed area. (Source: @New_security8200/203275)

An IDF interceptor was launched at a target in the southern Lebanon security zone that was later identified as friendly fire from Israeli forces; no injuries occurred, no alerts were activated, and the incident is under investigation. (Source: @New_security8200/203277)

IDF communications personnel from the 401st Armored Brigade and 12th Golani Battalion operated deep in southern Lebanon's wadis and mountainous terrain, maintaining connectivity despite Hezbollah's hidden infrastructure and changing weather. (Source: @idf_telegram/24871)

sections.threat_assessment: The convergence of Iranian missile threats, US maximum pressure rhetoric, and Israeli entrenchment across three fronts creates a high-probability escalation corridor. Iran's declared 'last missile' doctrine combined with Trump's 'very, very hard' strike option suggests a narrowing diplomatic window. Israel's permanent security zone declaration in Lebanon, Syria, and Gaza signals a strategic shift from temporary operations to enduring occupation, likely provoking sustained asymmetric responses. The US kinetic action in the Gulf of Oman and Iraq's firm coalition expulsion deadline further destabilize the regional security architecture, increasing the risk of miscalculation across multiple theaters simultaneously.
sections.regional_response: Caspian Sea states face Iranian diplomatic pressure to condemn Israel and Ukraine, testing regional alignment. Turkey's Erdogan hosting Abbas signals continued Palestinian diplomatic engagement amid Gaza operations. Lebanon's volunteer alert networks and army engineering operations reflect a society bracing for sustained conflict. Iraq's unilateral coalition expulsion deadline represents a major shift in US military posture in Mesopotamia. Gulf maritime traffic data shows minimal adoption of US-backed transit routes, indicating skepticism of American security guarantees. Yemen's Houthi leadership continues to frame its campaign as a sovereignty struggle despite US-UK strikes.
sections.intelligence_notes: The simultaneous appearance of IRGC missile launch reports toward Hormuz and US helicopter engagement in the Gulf of Oman suggests active but undeclared naval confrontation. IDF's friendly-fire interceptor incident in southern Lebanon reveals operational friction in dense battlespace. Israeli civilian incursions into West Bank Area C under military protection indicate settler-military coordination challenges. The Peace Council's violation monitoring mechanism in Gaza implies a formalized ceasefire enforcement structure not previously acknowledged. North Korea's nuclear submarine threat, while extra-regional, reflects a broader axis coordination narrative. Oil pollution on Qeshm Island adds environmental dimension to Hormuz Strait tensions.
